symptom: A hand-edited MCP server that sealed a variable under a name no process can read ("API-KEY") made composing the MCP registry throw, so every Local chat failed to start instead of leaving out that one server.
rule: Turn each saved entry into a registration on its own: a broken entry keeps its name, shows why it is unavailable, and never stops its siblings. Test with entries a person can write by hand (principle 13).
check: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/desktop/src/engine/agents/__tests__/mcp-registry.test.ts -t 'saved variable cannot be referenced'
